raw_record.question_text: In the diagram below, $ABCDEFGH$ is a rectangular prism, $\angle BAF = 30^o$ and $\angle DAH = 60^o$. What is the cosine of $\angle CEG$?

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate-vector model. From the diagram, read A as the lower front-left vertex, B lower front-right, D lower back-left, E upper front-left, F upper front-right, G lower back-right, and C upper back-right of the rectangular prism. From the text, use \(\angle BAF=30^\circ\) on the front face \(ABFE\) and \(\angle DAH=60^\circ\) on the left face \(ADHE\). Let \(AB=x\), \(AD=y\), \(AE=z\). In right triangle \(ABF\), \(\tan 30^\circ=z/x\), so \(z=x/\sqrt3\). In right triangle \(ADH\), \(\tan 60^\circ=z/y\), so \(z=\sqrt3y\), hence \(x=3y\). Set \(y=1\), so \((x,y,z)=(3,1,\sqrt3)\). Assign coordinates \(E=(0,0,z)\), \(C=(x,y,z)\), \(G=(x,y,0)\). Then \(\vec{EC}=(x,y,0)\) and \(\vec{EG}=(x,y,-z)\). Compute \(\cos\angle CEG=\frac{\vec{EC}\cdot\vec{EG}}{|EC||EG|}=\frac{x^2+y^2}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}}=\frac{\sqrt{10}}{\sqrt{13}}=\frac{\sqrt{130}}{13}\).
